title: Tithe
subtitle: the men they send
narrative: Every institution has a face it shows when it comes to collect. A noble on her throne with the servant scrubbing the floor in front of her. A knight extending a collection plate. A vampire priest mid-strike with the dagger raised. A red-haired mage radiating cracked light. The bundle holds ten cards. Different guilds, different blocks, same job description. Most TCG art lets these figures pass as background dignity. This one does not.

cards.name: Wicked Guardian
cards.why_it_fits: A crowned noblewoman seated on a stone throne under elaborate dark arches. A servant on hands and knees in the foreground, scrubbing the floor. The frame holds them both in one shot. Flavor text: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors." Mark Rosewater's Eldraine preview essay named this card as part of the set's Cinderella arc; the inequality is the design.

cards.name: Charity Extractor
cards.why_it_fits: One armored knight in profile, ornate teal-and-gold plate, right hand held forward with a shallow collection plate. Cathedral or temple architecture behind. Flavor text: "War or no war, your donations are due, as always."

cards.name: Pitiless Pontiff
cards.why_it_fits: Vampire priest with dark hair, dagger raised in her right hand, the other hand reaching down toward a victim out of frame. Behind her head a gold filigree sunburst halo, the church's design language. Flavor text: "Pay in gold. Pay in blood. Pay with the servitude of your spirit kin. But pay you must."

cards.name: Mortify
cards.why_it_fits: Red-haired figure in dark formal attire, light radiating outward from her chest in a stylized motion-blur composition. Flavor text: "Your debt is erased." Attributed to Hilgur, an Orzhov euthanist. The word euthanist tells you what the erasure costs.

cards.name: Tithe Drinker
cards.why_it_fits: Vampire seated on an elaborate stone throne, two attendant figures flanking her at lower height. Heavy gold ornamentation on the throne. The card is named for the figure's job: collecting blood and coin on the Orzhov's behalf. MTG lore frames the Orzhov as the Church of Deals, part church and part bank.

cards.name: Lawmage's Binding
cards.why_it_fits: A horned red-skinned captive bound by white-and-blue chains of magic, body twisted in the wrappings. The casters aren't in the frame. The institution is the bindings themselves. First instant-speed Pacifism in MTG history per the set's design retrospective, written to outpace the defendant.

cards.name: Lunarch Mantle
cards.why_it_fits: A dark-armored figure with huge white angel wings spread behind them, sword pointed downward at the ground. The card is the Aura, not the figure. The wings are added to the soldier the church already had. Flavor speaker: Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor of the Lunarch Inquisition.

cards.name: Reverent Hoplite
cards.why_it_fits: A single mounted rider in armor, banner raised, framed against the stylized Theros night-sky constellation field. The card creates a token for every devotion-to-white permanent you control, so one rider on the card is the entire formation a buyer assembles around it. Flavor text: "Zeal is the sharpest blade, and piety the strongest shield."

cards.name: Secure the Scene
cards.why_it_fits: One armored officer with a vertical staff raised, blue magical glow radiating around the staff. Flavor text by Judith the Scourge Diva, a Rakdos character calling out an Azorius arrest: "You know it's a great show when the Azorius arrest the props, too!" Two copies of this one in the bundle; the institution rarely arrives alone.

pricing.diy_alternative_note: Ten cards across seven sets means ~3-4 TCGplayer sellers minimum at plain-envelope rates. Realistic floor; could be higher.
pricing.shipping_policy: buyer-paid, itemized separately at checkout; never included in list price
pricing.premium_justification: The $2.39 above cost basis pays for the framing. Ten cards of common bulk are $1.61 of paper. The bundle's value is reading the cards in sequence with the title doing the lifting.

metadata.notes: v4 recast. Theme tightened from 'Sleep when you're dead' (interior labor experience) to 'Tithe' (the apparatus of extraction, the men they send). Anchors: Wicked Guardian, Charity Extractor, Pitiless Pontiff. Dropped Mind Rot (interior body-horror) and Deafening Silence (victims rather than face of institution). Added Mortify, Tithe Drinker, Lunarch Mantle, Reverent Hoplite, Secure the Scene (2x). Secure the Scene at 2x leverages the only multi-copy candidate in the match set.
